description: This Java source file defines the 'FileBasedTenantService' class, which implements tenant management functionalities for a cloud IoT platform. It manages tenant data stored in-memory and persisted in a file, supporting operations like load, save, add, remove, update, and retrieve tenants. The class also handles tenant data versioning, conflict checking, and optional tenant file persistence configuration.

classes.name: FileBasedTenantService
classes.description: A tenant service implementation managing tenants in-memory with file persistence, supporting CRUD operations, versioning, conflict detection, and optional automatic file saving.

methods.name: loadTenantData
methods.description: Loads tenant data from the configured file during startup.

methods.name: checkFileExists
methods.description: Checks existence of tenant file, creating it if missing and allowed.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Deserializes tenants from JSON array buffer and adds to internal storage.

methods.name: addTenant
methods.description: Adds a tenant from a JSON representation.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Persists current tenant data to file if modified.

methods.name: getTenantResult
methods.description: Retrieves tenant data with status and version info.

methods.name: getForCertificateAuthority
methods.description: Finds tenant associated with a given CA subject distinguished name.

methods.name: removeTenant
methods.description: Removes a tenant if resource version matches.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new tenant with optional ID, generating one if not provided.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing tenant info if resource version matches.

methods.name: convertTenant
methods.description: Converts tenant object to JSON, with optional filtering of authorities.

methods.name: getByCa
methods.description: Finds tenant entry associated with a specific CA DN.
